summary: Significant gaps in line/service association and low-confidence service descriptions across many rows. Most issues stem from missing or insufficient geometry evidence, especially for hardwired IO and safety-related instruments. Passive/mechanical rows are generally acceptable, but active and safety-critical tags require manual review due to lack of deterministic evidence.

comments.issue: Service description has low confidence and is based only on tag type.
comments.reason: Service should be confirmed from P&ID or legend for accuracy.
comments.evidence_needed: P&ID legend or explicit service callout.

comments.issue: No line association; geometry evidence does not provide a line.
comments.reason: Line association is critical for flow elements to ensure correct process mapping.
comments.evidence_needed: Clear line tag from P&ID or geometry.
